title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and auto-labeling policies for non-Microsoft connected apps
summary: Hold: the auto-labeling creation path skips the required label-selection pages, and the statement that no budget control is documented overlooks Azure Cost Management budgets. The rollout, application coverage and pay-as-you-go meter are supported, but Microsoft's conflicting cut-over instructions should also be disclosed.

claims.claim: Microsoft instructs administrators to turn off or delete overlapping file policies before creating the Purview policy.
claims.quote: Before you create Microsoft Purview policy for any of these non-Microsoft applications, turn off or delete any Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps file policies for the same non-Microsoft locations.
claims.fix: Keep the notice's instruction but add: 'Microsoft's sources disagree on sequencing: MC1449180 says to turn off or delete overlapping file policies before creating the Purview policy, while Learn's migration page says to disable them only after validating and turning on Purview policies. Resolve this conflict with Microsoft before cut-over.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-cloud-apps/migrate-file-policies-to-purview, which says 'Disable Defender for Cloud Apps policies only after you validate and turn on the Purview policies.'

claims.claim: No cap or budget control is documented for this Azure-billed meter.

Narrow the corresponding Open questions item to the feature-specific hard cap.
